title: A novel photo-regulated self-healing hydrogel based on hollow SiO2@g-C3N4@TiO2 and PVA
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21300-21310
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01507C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yu-Ling Qi, Hao-Yu Zhou, Guo-Zhi Han
A novel kind of photo-regulated self-healing hydrogel was developed by freezing–thawing method. The synchronous growth of Young's modulus, tensile strength and self-healing performance were achieved by visible light irradiation.
